summary.text: Andrew Farmer is a Republican state representative and attorney who has represented Tennessee House of Representatives District 17 since 2012, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Andrew Farmer received a B.A. in business administration from East Tennessee State University and later a J.D. from Thomas M. Cooley Law School, and his professional experience includes serving as an attorney.
In the 2023-2024 session he chaired the Civil Justice Committee and was assigned to the Calendar and Rules, Criminal Justice, Health, Naming and Designating, and House Rules committees.
Farmer and his wife, Mariah, have two children and live in Sevierville, Tennessee.
